products.name: 01.AI Yi
products.note: Chinese open-source LLM; Kai-Fu Lee founded; cross-border data review advised

profile_text.body:
01.AI is an enterprise AI company founded in Beijing in May 2023 under the leadership of Dr. Kai-Fu Lee. The company describes itself as helping enterprises make AI transformation a measurable operating result through what it calls a top-down strategy, covering deployment, secure delivery, and enterprise agents. It reached unicorn status within six months of founding and targets sectors including supply chain, logistics, manufacturing, energy, agriculture, investment, education, and retail, with noted partnerships such as one with Fortune Global 500 company Charoen Pokphand Group focused on AI and smart agriculture.

The company's product portfolio centers on full-stack enterprise solutions and agentic AI applications. It has released TrueNorth, described as an enterprise AI decision hub platform, along with extensions branded as Boss AI, Investor AI, and TopSales AI. It also offers the WorldWise Enterprise LLM Platform, built on a self-developed end-to-end foundation-model technology stack and covering model deployment, application practice, and fine-tuning tools. Its Yi-Lightning model, described as a 100B-parameter MoE model, is reported to have ranked sixth globally and first in China on the LMSYS blind test.

The site's held facts identify the company's tracked product as 01.AI Yi, a Chinese open-source large language model associated with Dr. Kai-Fu Lee, with a note that cross-border data review is advised. No litigation cases or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company at this time.
